text_to_speech: I think like every child you have big dreams of where you can go but it wasn't always easy and clear that I would get there so I'm happy that I've been able to make it here and one of the key reasons for that is through access to education and education is a key human rights issue I have tried to make Kenya a more equal society that even a child born in a place like Cabrera has got more hope I think as we celebrate the 70th anniversary of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights for me as a Kenyan I am proud to say that the Kenyan Constitution has taken the spirit and the letter and the words of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and codified it in our Constitution both on the political and civil rights as well as the economic cultural and social rights which now we just have to implement and be more committed to implement
